source_string: To add or change an NPC in your world, first make yourself a world builder with "/wb".
translation: Para agrega o cambia un NPC na tuyo mundo, primero hace tu un Plantador de Mundo con "/wb".

source_string: There's a brand new build challenge every month! Find them all in the Library under Monthly Build Challenges.
translation: Tiene un nuevo build challenge cada mes! Encuentra todo na Library debajo de Monthly Build Challenges.

source_string: Find related lessons by clicking on tags in the Library.
translation: Encuentra maga relacionao lesson con click na maga tag na Library.

source_string: Game moving slowly? Try turning down the render distance in Settings.
translation: Ta hinay el juego? Proba baja el render distance na Configuraciones.

source_string: Want to use Code Builder? Make sure cheats are toggled on.
translation: Quiere usa el Code Builder? Asegura que on el maga cheat.

source_string: Press F5 to change player perspective.
translation: Pichi F5 para cambia el perspectiva del jugador.

source_string: Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!
translation: Usa "/spawnpoint" para cambia tuyo spawn point. Parece lang ya duerme tu na cama!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: Mayor parte de maga monstruo sale lang na noche. Durante el dia seguro tu... probablemente.

source_string: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the crafting grid to make helpful items. Now you're crafting!
translation: Rompe maga bloque, saca maga resource. Usa el crafting grid para hace maga util item. Ahora ta hace ya tu!

source_string: You have endless lives, but your items drop to the ground when you die. Hurry back to pick them up!
translation: Tiene tu infinito vida, pero ta cae na suelo tuyo maga item cuando muri tu. Apura vira para saca!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: Buen idea construi un lugar donde puede tu pasa seguro el noche.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Usa el correcto herramienta para el trabajo! Mas rapido corta madera con hacha que con tuyo mano.

source_string: Even in Minecraft you'll get hungry, so try to find something to eat before that happens.
translation: Hasta na Minecraft ay gutom tu, por eso proba busca algo para come antes que sucede ese.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Cava derecho abajo o derecho arriba puede hende buen idea.

source_string: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.
translation: Ta spawn el maga monstruo na escuro. Hace un antorcha para ilumina cualquier espacio.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Bien bueno el maga cama! Hace uno para pasa rapido el noche y pone tuyo respawn point.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Cuidao cuando ta nada tu. Si queda mucho tiempo tu debajo de agua ay acaba tuyo aire.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: El Modo Supervivencia tiene 4 diferente nivel de dificultad - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, y Hard. O juga Modo Creativo y tiene maga resource infinito!

source_string: The world of Minecraft is endlessly surprising. You'll find lots of different animals, plants, and even §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r
translation: El mundo del Minecraft siempre sorprendente. Ay encuentra tu tanto diferente animal, planta, y hasta §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Ay pelea por contigo el maga golem de fierro!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Dale hueso na lobo para hace manso. Despues puede tu hace sentao o sigui contigo.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Si usa tu calabaza na cabeza, no ay ataca contigo el maga Enderman.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Cosecha cuero de maga baca, y usa para hace armadura y maga libro.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Puede tu llena un balde vacio con agua, lava, leche, powdered snow... y hasta algunos mob.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Si dale come tu un animal, no ay despawn. Construi un corral para guarda seguro tuyo maga animal.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Llega mas rapido na tuyo destino con minecart y poco riles!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: Si construi tu un portal, puede tu viaja na otro dimension que llama Nether.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: El Bonemeal (hecho del hueso del esqueleto) puede usa como fertilizante y puede hace crece instantaneo!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Ta crea el Obsidiana cuando topa el agua con un fuente de lava.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Si quita el source block del agua o lava, ay para completo el flujo.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Maga bloque que puede usa como luz ay derrite nieve y hielo.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Cuidao cuando construi maga estructura de lana na abierto, porque el rayo de tormenta puede quema el lana.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Un balde de lava puede usa na horno para funde 100 bloque.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: El instrumento que ta toca el bloque de nota depende del material debajo.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: Si ataca tu un lobo, todo el maga lobo cerca ay hostil y ay ataca contigo.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: El maga lobo y golem de fierro no ay ataca el maga creeper.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: El maga gallina ta pone un huevo cada 5 hasta 10 minuto.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Puede mina el Obsidiana con Pico de Diamante.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: El maga creeper el mas facil fuente de polvora.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: El maga lobo manso ta mostra su salud con posicion de su cola. Dale carne para sana.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Puede hace diferente colorao tina de varios material, cocina cactus na horno para recibi Tina Verde!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: El maga baboy que ya ataca del rayo ay hace zombified piglin.
Ta odia el maga Enderman el hora de baño!

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: A veces el maga golem de fierro ta dale flor na maga bata del barrio!
El maga ocelot ta mostra na maga creeper quien el jefe!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Usa seagrass para atrae y cria maga tortuga del mar.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
translation: Protege maga tortuga bebe de maga mob hostil!

source_string: Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: El maga bebe tortuga ay suelta scute cuando crece - puede hace este na caparazon de tortuga.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
translation: Hace poco potion de Respiracion na Agua para explora debajo de agua!

source_string: Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: El maga delfin puede guia contigo na maga barco hundido y ruina debajo de agua, dale bacalao y sigui su rastro!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
translation: Usa tijera para talla un calabaza.

source_string: There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Puede funde el sea pickle para recibi tina verde lima.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Usa maga bale de heno para cria maga Llama!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: El maga compass siempre ta apunta na world spawn - hace uno para encuentra tuyo camino!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Man trade con maga aldeano para recibi comida, herramienta, y hasta explorer maga mapa!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Sabe ba tu que puede tu sostiene un mapa na tuyo off-hand?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Puede usa el maga lead na maga barco.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Agacha para camina seguro na maga bloque de magma.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: Puede tu recoge telaraña con tijera.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: El Trident ta suelta del Sumido, y puede sostiene o tira.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Puede funde 20 item na horno con un bloque de Quelpo Secao como combustible.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: No necesita silla para hace manso un Calavera-caballo.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: El maga Phantom peligroso mob que ta sale durante el noche. Asegura duerme regular!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Ay hace Sumido el maga zombi si hunde na agua.
No mata el maga delfin, monstruo!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Cuando ta cava derecho arriba, pone antorcha na tuyo pie para rompe cualquier arena o grava que puede cae contigo.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Corta un Colmena o nido para recibi Uglan, usa Botella para recibi miel.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Pone un fogata debajo de colmena o nido para cosecha miel.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: El maga mena de Esmeralda el mas raro na Minecraft! Puede encuentra lang na maga montaña y pradera.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Necesita diamante? Mas comun cuando mas profundo ta anda tu.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: El maga rana ta come chiquito y blocky maga mob.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: El Allay gusta colecta maga item! Si dale tu un cierto item, ay proba colecta mas de ese.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: El maga rana ta escoge un variante segun el temperatura del biome donde ya crece el tadpole.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
translation: Puede tu colecta maga tadpole na balde.

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Puede encuentra maga ciudad antiguo debajo de maga cordillera.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: El maga Allay gusta musica y por eso ta interactua con maga noteblock!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Usa un botella de agua na bloque de tierra para recibi lodo!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Cuando ta viaja na Oscuridad Profundo, el silencio el clave.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Algunos animal ay sigui contigo si tiene tu trigo na mano.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Antes de mina diamante, redstone, o oro, asegura que ta usa tu un pico de fierro o diamante o no ay funciona.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Si pone tu dos baul lado por lado ay hace un Grande Baul.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: No puede encuentra carbon para tuyo antorcha? Proba pone poco Trozo na horno.
Maga maravilla infinito, maga posibilidad sin fin.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Siembra poco sapling y ay crece como arbol.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Usa azada para prepara maga area del suelo para siembra.

source_string: Zombified piglins won't attack you - unless you make them angry.
translation: El maga zombified piglin no ay ataca contigo - a menos que hace tu enojao sila.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Golpea otra vez el maga fireball na Ghast!

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: El Escombro resistente na fireball del Ghast, util para guarda maga portal.

source_string: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.
translation: Nuestro musica de C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, y Kumi Tanioka.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Tiene un update para este juego eventualmente!

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Ya nace el maga creeper de un coding bug.

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: Ya crea el primero version del Minecraft na 6 dia lang!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: El idioma del Enderman English na reverse.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: El original nombre del Minecraft Cave Game.

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: Un Spider Jockey el raro aparicion de un Gagamba montao por un esqueleto!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
translation: Viaja un bloque na Nether igual con viaja ocho bloque na Supramundo.

source_string: Use phantom membranes to repair your elytra.
translation: Usa phantom membrane para repara tuyo Elytra.

source_string: Elytra can be used to glide, find them in End city ships!
translation: Puede usa el Elytra para planea, encuentra na maga barco del Ciudad del End!

source_string: Test out some new features by turning on Experimental Gameplay in the settings menu!
translation: Proba algunos nuevo feature con on el Experimental Gameplay na menu de configuraciones!

source_string: Monsters that are killed by skeletons arrows have a chance of dropping music discs.
translation: El maga monstruo que ya mata del flecha de esqueleto tiene chance suelta music disc.

source_string: Texture packs change the way that blocks, items, and even the menus look in game. Try them out!
translation: El maga texture pack ta cambia el itsura de maga bloque, item, y hasta maga menu na juego. Proba!

source_string: Using firework rockets boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
translation: Usa firework rocket para aumenta el velocidad del Elytra na aire. Pero... asegura que no explota, sino ay doler BIEN!
Lee ba gayot este el maga gente?

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: El encantamiento Contracorriente ay empuja contigo na aire durante lluvia.

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a Nether star from the Wither!
translation: El Farola un poderoso item que puede hace lang con Netherestrella del Wither!

source_string: Nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions.
translation: No puede destrui el maga Netherestrella con explosion.
Puede tu barter con maga piglin.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged respawn anchor.
translation: Para respawnea na Nether necesita un cargao Ancla de Vida.

source_string: You can charge a respawn anchor with glowstone.
translation: Puede tu carga un Ancla de Vida con glowstone.

source_string: You can breed hoglins with crimson fungus, but be careful.
translation: Puede tu cria maga hoglin con Ligbus Escarlata, pero cuidao.

source_string: Gold is most common in the Nether and in the badlands biome.
translation: El Oro mas comun na Nether y na biome de badlands.

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorita, o gusta tu o odia tu.

source_string: Take a screenshot using the Game menu.
translation: Toma un screenshot usando el Menu de juego.

source_string: A Realm is always online, so you and your friends can play here whenever you want.
translation: Siempre online el Realm, por eso puede juga tu y tuyo maga amigo aqui cuando quiere.

source_string: Keep up to date with what's going on in your Realm by checking the Story Feed in Realms Stories.
translation: Sabe lo que ta pasa na tuyo Realm con chequea el Story Feed na Realms Stories.

source_string: Share your great moments with the other players on this Realm by adding a story to the Story Feed.
translation: Comparti tuyo maga bueno momento con otros jugadores na este Realm con agrega un story na Story Feed.

source_string: Check the Timeline in Realms Stories to find out when others are playing.
translation: Chequea el Timeline na Realms Stories para sabe cuando ta juga el otros.

source_string: Access Realms Stories from the game menu while playing on the Realm.
translation: Acceso el Realms Stories del menu de juego mientras ta juga na Realm.

source_string: Get to know your Realm's community on the Members tab in Realms Stories.
translation: Conoce el community del tuyo Realm na tab Miembro na Realms Stories.

source_string: Use Realms Stories to get social, keep up with your friends' progress, and organize playtime.
translation: Usa Realms Stories para man social, sigui el progreso de tuyo maga amigo, y organiza tiempo de juga.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
translation: Aburrio de gravedad? Brinca dos veces para vuela!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
translation: Espawnea maga mob na un instante con spawn egg.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Colecta Cuerno de Cabrito y llena el mundo con musica.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Combina Encendedor con un bloque de TNT para explosivo resultado.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Proba blink na mapa con Enderperlas. No ay mareao!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Usa riles y minecart para construi el perfecto sistema de transporte. O rollercoaster!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Busca poco mas peligro? El Modo Supervivencia tiene bastante.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: El maga crossbow necesita ammo. Agrega maga flecha na tuyo inventory antes de anda caza.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: No puede muri tu, pero puede el maga aldeano. Usa ese informacion... con juicio.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: El maga aldeano bien bueno na construi maga barrio. Puede tu mas bueno?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Ay ataca el maga lobo na maga esqueleto para mastica su sabroso hueso.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Hace manso el salvaje caballo con sienta encima hasta tranquilo, despues pone silla y monta. (Nota: No ta funciona asi el maga caballo fuera del Minecraft.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Come cuanto quiere tu, nunca ay lleno! Y nunca ay gutom.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Pasa na solido maga objeto usando Modo Espectador.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Quien necesita herramienta? Golpea tuyo camino para exito y quita maga bloque instantaneo na modo creativo.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Gusta ba tu el mira? Usa el pick block button para principia construi con cualquier cosa que ta mira tu. Si, hasta maga mob!
context: There is a feature called “Pick block” that enables players to instantly equip any block they click on. If you click on a mob(animal or monster) you will get a spawn egg that summons another monster/animal of that kind.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: El maga mob no ay nota contigo na modo creativo, pero ay nota pa sila uno con otro…
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: Un warden cada dia ta mantiene lejos... bueno, todo.
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Por que no construi un base debajo de agua? No puede ahoga tu.
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: Cualquier cosa que puede soña tu, puede construi tu. No tiene limite tuyo maga resource (na modo creativo...).
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: El maga Phantom no puede hace daño contigo, pero puede tu espanta con usa cama. Pero...no literal. Duerme tu na ese.
context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...
translation: Ya proba ba tu nada na lava? Parece ta hunde na baño caliente. Pero no proba na Modo Supervivencia...
context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A second player can't join right now.
translation: No puede entra ahora un segundo jugador.

source_string: You have too many controllers connected while in Local Network Mode to join this game.
translation: Tiene tu mucho controller conectao na Local Network Mode para entra na este juego.

source_string: Some worlds are not available because they could not be moved. Restart Minecraft to try again.
translation: Algunos mundo no disponible porque no ya puede mueve. Reinicia Minecraft para proba otra vez.

source_string: Read the FAQ for more info.
translation: Lee el FAQ para mas de info.

source_string: You don't have enough free space to move your files to a new location.
translation: No tiene tu suficiente libre espacio para mueve tuyo maga archivo na nuevo lugar.

source_string: We need to move your files to a different location on your device.
translation: Necesita kame mueve tuyo maga archivo na diferente lugar na tuyo device.

source_string: We're in the middle of moving your data to a new location on your device. Please press resume to finish the move.
translation: Ta medio kame na mueve tuyo data na nuevo lugar na tuyo device. Por favor pichi resume para acaba el mueve.

source_string: We're in the middle of moving your data to a new location on your device, but you don't have enough free space.
translation: Ta medio kame na mueve tuyo data na nuevo lugar na tuyo device, pero no tiene tu suficiente libre espacio.

source_string: Please free up at least %s to continue.
translation: Por favor libera por lo menos %s para sigui.

source_string: Your files have been moved successfully. Please restart Minecraft.
translation: Ya mueve ya tuyo maga archivo. Por favor reinicia Minecraft.

source_string: We couldn't move all your files. We encountered the following error: (%s).
translation: No ya puede kame mueve todo tuyo maga archivo. Ya encuentra kame el siguiente error: (%s).
Ta colecta maga archivo del source folder...

source_string: Failed (file I/O error or no space left)
translation: Falla (file I/O error o no mas espacio)

source_string: We put your world on a super-computer, with a huge amount of speed and power. We keep the computer running all the time so you can play that world whenever you and your friends want. We protect your world from getting corrupted by saving it automatically all the time. You control who connects to the world. How you play with it is up to you (the server will do all the heavy lifting).

Ta mantene kame el computer ta funciona todo el tiempo para puede juga tu ese mundo cuando quiere tu y tuyo maga amigo. Ta protege kame tuyo mundo para no corrupto por ta salva automatico todo el tiempo. Tu el controla quien ta conecta na mundo. Como juga tu con eso, de tuyo ya (el server ay hace todo el trabajo pesao).

Diferente con un regular sesion de multijugador, el Realms siempre online, entonces no necesita tu estar ahi para juga el maga amigo de tuyo. Diferente con un grande public server de Minecraft, el Realms por invitacion solamente, entonces tu el controla quien puede entra.

source_string: Welcome to Minecraft Editor, a powerful tool for creating stunning Bedrock worlds with ease.[*newLine]Things work differently in Editor and it's important that you understand a few basics first or you might get lost.[*newLine]Let's dive into the basics.
translation: Bienvenido na Minecraft Editor, un herramienta poderoso para crea maga mundo magnifico de Bedrock na facil.[*newLine]Diferente el manera de funciona na Editor y importante que entende tu primero el algunos basico o puede perdi tu.[*newLine]Empeza ya kita na basico.

source_string: We are so excited you're here and about to build with Minecraft's Bedrock Editor, where we want to empower Creators of all skillsets to easily create high-quality experiences.
translation: Contento kame que aqui tu y ta quere construi con el Bedrock Editor del Minecraft, donde gusto kame empodera el maga Creador de todo nivel para crea facilmente maga experiencia de alto calidad.

source_string: - There are two modes within the Editor: Tool or Crosshair. Tool is focused on using the multi-block editing tools as available via the UI and free-moving cursor, and Crosshair is for more precise, single-block edits using a crosshair in 1st person.
translation: - Tiene dos modo na Editor: Tool o Crosshair. El Tool ta enfoca na uso de maga herramienta de edita multi-bloque disponible por el UI y cursor libre, y el Crosshair para mas preciso edita de un bloque con mira na primera persona.

source_string: - UI orientation: The left array of tools is referred to as the "toolrail", the top array is the "action bar" (eg. undo/redo), and the very top is the "menu" (eg. File).
translation: - Orientacion del UI: El fila de herramienta na izquierda ta llama "toolrail", el fila na arriba el "barra de accion" (ejemplo undo/redo), y el mas arriba el "menu" (ejemplo File).

source_string: - For most UI actions and tools, there is a corresponding hotkey and sometimes a slash cmd.
translation: - Para mayoria de accion y herramienta del UI, tiene hotkey correspondiente y a veces slash cmd.

source_string: - Rotate camera / unlock movement: In Tool, hold down right mouse button. In Crosshair, you do not need to hold down the right mouse button.
translation: - Gira el camera / abri el movimiento: Sa Tool, pichi tarda el boton derecho del mouse. Sa Crosshair, no necesita pichi tarda el boton derecho del mouse.

source_string: - Move on the XZ axis: WASD
- Move on the Y axis: E (up), Q (down)
translation: - Move na eje Y: E (arriba), Q (abajo)
- Abri el ventana de slash command: /

source_string: - Toggle between Tool and Crosshair Modes: (CTRL+TAB) or the UI button at the bottom of the viewport. When in Crosshair, you will need to use the hotkeys, though -- (CTRL+TAB) or ESC.
translation: - Alterna entre Modo Tool y Crosshair: (CTRL+TAB) o el boton del UI na fondo del viewport. Cuando na Crosshair, necesita usa el hotkey -- (CTRL+TAB) o ESC.

source_string: At the top center of your screen is the Hotbar. Click once to change the active block, click twice to open the Block Picker to customize the Hotbar.
translation: Sa centro arriba del screen tiene el Hotbar. Click una vez para cambia el bloque activo, click dos veces para abri el Selector de Bloque para personaliza el Hotbar.

source_string: You can create a new Hotbar by clicking the Hotbar Menu button to the right.

source_string: To navigate in the Editor, you’ll need a keyboard and mouse. Trackpads or controllers aren’t recommended.
translation: Para navega na Editor, necesita tu keyboard y mouse. No recomendao el trackpad o controller.

translation: Si tene tu un item na tuyo mano, usa :windowsmr_left_trigger: para usa ese item o pichi :windowsmr_right_grab: para tira.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, touch the screen to use that item or touch and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it.
translation: Si tene tu un item na tuyo mano, toca el screen para usa ese item o toca y sostene el item na tuyo hotbar para tira.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Mucho util el agacha na Minecraft, ta evita el agacha que cae tu de un bloque y ta esconde tuyo nametag. Para agacha, sostene :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :_input_key.sneak: or click :_gamepad_stick_right:.
translation: Mucho util el agacha na Minecraft, ta evita el agacha que cae tu de un bloque y ta esconde tuyo nametag. Para alterna agacha, pichi :_input_key.sneak: o click :_gamepad_stick_right:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, tap :touch_sneak:.
translation: Mucho util el agacha na Minecraft, ta evita el agacha que cae tu de un bloque y ta esconde tuyo nametag. Para alterna agacha, toca :touch_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :rift_X:.
translation: Mucho util el agacha na Minecraft, ta evita el agacha que cae tu de un bloque y ta esconde tuyo nametag. Para alterna agacha, pichi :rift_X:.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To toggle sneak, press :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Mucho util el agacha na Minecraft, ta evita el agacha que cae tu de un bloque y ta esconde tuyo nametag. Para alterna agacha, pichi :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the mouse to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Si sprint tu na agua, ay nada tu. Usa el mouse para controla el direccion donde ta nada tu.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :_gamepad_stick_right: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Si sprint tu na agua, ay nada tu. Usa el :_gamepad_stick_right: para controla el direccion donde ta nada tu.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Touch and drag along the screen to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Si sprint tu na agua, ay nada tu. Toca y arrastra na screen para controla el direccion donde ta nada tu.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :rift_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Si sprint tu na agua, ay nada tu. Usa el :rift_right_stick: para controla el direccion donde ta nada tu.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :windowsmr_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Si sprint tu na agua, ay nada tu. Usa el :windowsmr_right_stick: para controla el direccion donde ta nada tu.

source_string: Press :_input_key.inventory: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :_input_key.inventory: para accesa el Libro de Receta y Cuadricula de Hacida.

source_string: Press :_input_container.crafting: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :_input_container.crafting: para accesa el Libro de Receta y Cuadricula de Hacida.

source_string: Tap the Inventory Button to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Toca el Boton de Inventario para acceso el Libro de Receta y Cuadricula de Hacida.

source_string: Press :rift_B: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :rift_B: para accesa el Libro de Receta y Cuadricula de Hacida.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :windowsmr_left_grab: para accesa el Libro de Receta y Cuadricula de Hacida.

source_string: Arrange items from your Inventory or Hotbar in the crafting grid in the shape of an item recipe.
translation: Arregla el maga item de tuyo Inventario o Hotbar na cuadricula de hacida na forma de receta del item.

source_string: If the recipe is correct the item you are attempting to craft will appear in the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid. Take it from the Output Slot and put it in your Inventory. You can now use the item.
translation: Si correcto el receta, el item que ta prova tu hace ay aparece na Slot de Output na derecha del Cuadricula de Hacida. Saca de Slot de Output y pone na tuyo Inventario. Puede usa tu ahora el item.

source_string: There are many recipes and for some you will need a larger Crafting Grid than the 2x2 grid that you start with.
translation: Tene mucho receta y para algunos necesita tu mas grande Cuadricula de Hacida que el cuadricula de 2x2 que ta principia tu.

source_string: Craft 4 Wooden Planks into a Crafting Table and place it in the world.
translation: Hace 4 Tablon de Madera para hace un Mesa de Hacida y pone na mundo.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :_input_key.use: na Mesa de Hacida na mundo para accesa un Cuadricula de Hacida de 3x3.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :_input_key.use: na Mesa de Hacida na mundo para accesa un Cuadricula de Hacida de 3x3.

source_string: Press :rift_right_grab: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :rift_right_grab: na Mesa de Hacida na mundo para accesa un Cuadricula de Hacida de 3x3.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_trigger: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Pichi :windowsmr_left_trigger: na Mesa de Hacida na mundo para accesa un Cuadricula de Hacida de 3x3.

source_string: Tap on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Toca na Mesa de Hacida na mundo para acceso un Cuadricula de Hacida de 3x3.

source_string: On the left side of the screen you will see the Recipe Book, which is good if you don't know a recipe or want to quickly craft a recipe that you already know. You will also see the Crafting grid on the right side of the screen above your Inventory.
translation: Na lado izquierda del screen ay mira tu el Libro de Receta, que bueno si no sabe tu un receta o quiere hace rapido un receta que sabe ya tu. Ay mira tu tambien el Cuadricula de Hacida na lado derecha del screen arriba de tuyo Inventario.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, :_input_key.attack: the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then take it from the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid and put it in your Inventory. :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Cuando ya encontra tu el receta que quiere hace, :_input_key.attack: el receta para carga na cuadricula de hacida, despues saca de Slot de Output na derecha del Cuadricula de Hacida y pone na tuyo Inventario. :_input_key.use: el receta para auto-hace, este ta hace automatico un set y ta pone na tuyo inventario. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: el receta para auto-hace un stack completo.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, press :_gamepad_face_button_down: on the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. Press :_gamepad_face_button_up: on the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Cuando ya encontra tu el receta que quiere hace, pichi :_gamepad_face_button_down: na receta para auto-hace, este ta hace automatico un set y ta pone na tuyo inventario. Pichi :_gamepad_face_button_up: na receta para auto-hace un stack completo.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, tap the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then tap the item in the output slot to craft it. Press and hold the item in the output slot to craft continuously.
translation: Cuando ya encontra tu el receta que quiere hace, toca el receta para carga na cuadricula de hacida, despues toca el item na output slot para hace. Pichi tarda el item na output slot para hace continuo.

source_string: When the :craftable_toggle_on: is on, the Recipe Book shows all of the recipes that you have ingredients for. When the :craftable_toggle_off: is off, the Recipe Book shows every recipe in the game, even if you can't craft it. Check the tabs or search if you are looking for something specific. In Creative Mode some recipes will be collapsed inside lists. Opening the list will expand it and show you all of the recipes inside.
translation: Cuando :craftable_toggle_on: ta abri, ta mostra el Libro de Receta todo el receta que tene tu ingrediente. Cuando :craftable_toggle_off: ta cerra, ta mostra el Libro de Receta todo el receta na juego, maski no puede hace tu. Check el maga tab o busca si ta busca tu algo especifico. Na Modo Creativo algunos receta ay colapsa dentro de lista. Si abri el lista, ay expande y ay mostra todo el receta dentro.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, Tap :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, tap :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can press :touch_fly_up: to move up and :touch_fly_down: to move down.
translation: Para vuela cuando na Modo Creativo, toca :_input_key.jump: dos vez rapido. Para para vuela, repeti el accion. Para vuela mas rapido, toca :_input_key.forward: dos vez rapido mientras ta vuela. Cuando na modo de vuela, puede pichi tu :touch_fly_up: para move arriba y :touch_fly_down: para move abajo.

source_string: How to Play : Eye Of Ender
- Old worlds limited in size and height.
translation: - Maga mundo daan limitao na tamaño y altura.

source_string: -Mob Loot: Controls whether mobs will drop loot when they die.
translation: -Loot del Mob: Controla si ay cae loot el maga mob cuando muri.

source_string: -Mob Griefing: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
translation: -Ta Vandaliza el Mob: Ta evita que destruye el maga mob el mundo.

source_string: -Tile Drops: When this setting is turned on, blocks will drop themselves when they break.
translation: -Cae del Bloque: Cuando abierto este configuraciones, ay cae el bloque mismo cuando rompe.

source_string: -Entities Drop Loot: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: -Ta Cae Loot del Entidades: Controla si ay cae mismo el maga cosa como carro minero y soporte de armadura cuando rompe.

source_string: -Weather Cycle: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: -Ciclo del Clima: No ay cambia el clima cuando cerrao este configuraciones.

source_string: How to Play : Host and Player Options
translation: Paquilaya Juga : Opciones de Host y Jugador

source_string: The HUD shows information about your status, your health, your remaining oxygen (when you are underwater), your hunger level, and your armor (if you are wearing any).
translation: El HUD ta mostra informacion sobre tuyo estado, tuyo salud, tuyo oxigeno que queda (cuando debajo del agua tu), tuyo nivel de hambre, y tuyo armadura (si ta usa tu).

source_string: If you lose some health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will replenish. Eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: Si perde tu algun salud pero tene tu por lo menos nueve :shank:, ay recupera tuyo salud. Si come tu, ay recupera tuyo :shank:.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Pichi tarda :_input_key.use: mientras ta sostene tu un comida para come.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Pichi tarda :_input_key.use: mientras ta sostene tu un comida para come.

source_string: Press and hold :rift_right_grab: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Pichi tarda :rift_right_grab: mientras ta sostene tu un comida para come.

source_string: Press and hold :windowsmr_left_trigger: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Pichi tarda :windowsmr_left_trigger: mientras ta sostene tu un comida para come.

source_string: Press and hold a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Pichi tarda un comida para come.

source_string: You must watch your hunger level while adventuring, your hunger level is represented on your HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as you explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprinting. You can replenish your hunger level by eating food. Some foods are more nourishing than others and will fill up more :shank:. When you get your hunger level up to maximum, the last food you ate applies a saturation value. Saturation is a hidden number that gives you an extra bonus to your hunger level.
translation: Necesita tu mira tuyo nivel de hambre mientras ta aventura, el nivel de hambre ta representa na tuyo HUD con :shank:. Ta baja el nivel de hambre mientras ta explora tu. Algunos actividad ta baja mas rapido el nivel de hambre, como el sprint. Puede recupera tu el nivel de hambre con come. Algunos comida mas nutritivo que otro y ay llena mas :shank:. Cuando llega tu el nivel de hambre na maximo, el ultimo comida que ya come tu ta aplica un valor de saturacion. Saturacion un numero escondido que ta dale extra bonus na tuyo nivel de hambre.

source_string: The Experience Bar is also shown on the HUD. The number shows your current Experience Level, and the bar indicates how many Experience Points are required to increase your Experience Level.
translation: Ta mostra tambien na HUD el Barra de Experiencia. El numero ta mostra tuyo actual Nivel de Experiencia, y el barra ta indica cuantos Punto de Experiencia necesario para sube tuyo Nivel de Experiencia.

source_string: Experience Points are gained by collecting Experience Orbs. You can get Experience Orbs from activities such as killing mobs, mining certain blocks, and more! Don't leave any Experience Orbs behind, you're going to need them. Move near Experience Orbs to collect them.
translation: Ta consegui el Punto de Experiencia con recoge el Orbe de Experiencia. Puede consegui tu Orbe de Experiencia de actividad como mata mob, mina algunos bloque, y mas! No deja ningun Orbe de Experiencia, necesita tu ellos. Anda cerca na Orbe de Experiencia para recoge.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Scroll the mouse wheel to change the item in your hand.
translation: Ta mostra el hotbar el maga item que disponible para usa. Gira el rueda del mouse para cambia el item na tuyo mano.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to change the item in your hand.
translation: Ta mostra el hotbar el maga item que disponible para usa. Usa :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: y :_input_key.cycleItemRight: para cambia el item na tuyo mano.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Tap items in your hotbar to change the item in your hand.
translation: Ta mostra el hotbar el maga item que disponible para usa. Toca el maga item na tuyo hotbar para cambia el item na tuyo mano.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to change the item in your hand.
translation: Ta mostra el hotbar el maga item que disponible para usa. Pichi :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: para cambia el item na tuyo mano.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab: to change the item in your hand.
translation: Ta mostra el hotbar el maga item que disponible para usa. Pichi :rift_left_trigger: o :rift_left_grab: para cambia el item na tuyo mano.

source_string: This screen shows the items that are available for use in your hand, and all of the other items that you are carrying. Your armor is also shown here.
translation: Este screen ta mostra el maga item que disponible para usa na tuyo mano, y todo el otro maga item que ta lleva tu. Mostra tambien aqui tuyo armadura.

source_string: Use :mouse_left_button: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :mouse_right_button: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Usa :mouse_left_button: para recoge el item que debajo del cursor. Si tene mas de un item aqui, ay recoge todo, o puede usa tu :mouse_right_button: para recoge solamente mitad.

source_string: Use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :_gamepad_face_button_left: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Usa :_gamepad_face_button_down: para recoge el item que debajo del cursor. Si tene mas de un item aqui, ay recoge todo, o puede usa tu :_gamepad_face_button_left: para recoge solamente mitad.

source_string: Tap to select an item. If there is more than one item here this will select them all.
translation: Toca para escoge un item. Si tene mas de un item aqui, ay escoge todo.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :mouse_left_button:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :mouse_left_button: to place them all or :mouse_right_button: to place just one.
translation: Puede pone tu otra vez el maga item con usa :mouse_left_button:. Si tene mucho item na cursor, usa :mouse_left_button: para pone todo o :mouse_right_button: para pone solamente uno.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :_gamepad_face_button_down:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to place them all or :_gamepad_face_button_left: to place just one.
translation: Puede pone tu otra vez el maga item con usa :_gamepad_face_button_down:. Si tene mucho item na cursor, usa :_gamepad_face_button_down: para pone todo o :_gamepad_face_button_left: para pone solamente uno.

source_string: Tap another place in the inventory to move the item.
translation: Toca otro lugar na inventario para move el item.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.
translation: Si armadura el item que debajo del cursor, puede move paspas tu na correcto slot de armadura con pichi SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Si armadura el item que debajo del cursor, puede move paspas tu na correcto slot de armadura con pichi :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and put it down outside of the inventory window.
translation: Para tira un item, recoge el item y pone afuera del window de inventario.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and press :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Para tira un item, recoge el item y pichi :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, tap the item and then tap outside of the inventory window.
translation: Para tira un item, toca el item y despues toca afuera del window de inventario.

source_string: Minecraft is a multiplayer game by default.
translation: El Minecraft un juego multijugador por default.

source_string: You can have local players join your game by connecting controllers and pressing any button on their controller at any point during the game.
translation: Puede entra el maga jugador local na tuyo juego con conecta controller y pichi cualquier boton na controller de ellos na cualquier tiempo durante el juego.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Por default, todo el maga mundo ta principia con abierto el multijugador. Si quiere tu hace privado el mundo, anda na configuraciones del mundo y escoge el opcion de multijugador, despues cerra el multijugador.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Por default, todo el maga mundo ta principia con abierto el multijugador. Si quiere tu hace privado el mundo, anda na configuraciones del mundo y escoge el opcion de multijugador, despues cerra el multijugador.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Para entra na un juego multijugador, anda na tab de maga amigo. Todo el Realms que Puede Entra, Amigo, y Juego LAN ay mostra aqui. Escoge un juego y selecciona para entra.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Para entra na un juego multijugador, anda na tab de maga amigo. Todo el Realms que Puede Entra, Amigo, y Juego LAN ay mostra aqui. Escoge un juego y selecciona para entra.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, it will be visible to people in your friends tab. Once your friends join, the game will now be visible to friends of these friends.
translation: Cuando principia o entra tu na un juego online, ay mira el gente na tuyo tab de maga amigo. Cuando ya entra tuyo maga amigo, ay mira ya el juego del maga amigo de ellos.

source_string: Note: You must have an internet connection and be signed into Xbox Live to play multiplayer.
translation: Nota: Necesita tu tene conexion de internet y man sign in na Xbox Live para juga multijugador.

source_string: If you would like to manage the permissions of individual players, player permissions makes it easy. Open the pause menu and on the right, you will see a list of players currently in the world. Select their permission icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: Si quiere tu administra el permiso de individual maga jugador, facil con el permiso de jugador. Abri el menu de pausa y na derecha, ay mira tu un lista de maga jugador que na mundo con ahora. Escoge el icon de permiso de ellos para ajusta el permiso de ese jugador.

source_string: Realms is an awesome place to host a multiplayer game that is always running. Even when you aren't playing, your Realm will be up and running for your friends to explore!
translation: El Realms un mundo bueno para host un juego multijugador que siempre ta funciona. Maski no ta juga tu, tuyo Realm ay ta funciona para explora de tuyo maga amigo!

source_string: To set up a Realm, select Create New from the Worlds tab. Then select the New Realm button, then the Create New World button. Here you can name your Realm, and set the number of players. Then you will be able to add friends to your Realm.
translation: Para configura un Realm, escoge Crea Nuevo na tab de Maga Mundo. Despues escoge el boton Nuevo Realm, despues el boton Crea Nuevo Mundo. Aqui puede nombra tu el Realm, y pone el numero de jugador. Despues puede agrega tu maga amigo na tuyo Realm.

source_string: Once you have a Realm created, select the Pencil button to change the Realm settings.
translation: Cuando tene ya tu un Realm, escoge el boton Lapiz para cambia el configuraciones del Realm.

source_string: Under the Game button, you can rename the Realm, set the difficulty and gamemode, turn on cheats, and download/upload the world.
translation: Debajo del boton Juego, puede renombra tu el Realm, pone el dificultad y modo de juego, abri cheat, y download/upload el mundo.

source_string: Under the Members button you can manage all of the friends you've invited to your Realm, add/remove members, and set their permissions.
translation: Debajo del boton Miembro puede administra tu todo el maga amigo que ya invita tu na tuyo Realm, agrega/quita miembro, y pone el permiso de ellos.

source_string: Under the Subscription button you can see when the Realm will expire, extend the time until expiration, and open/close the Realm.
translation: Debajo del boton Subscription puede mira tu cuando ay expira el Realm, extende el tiempo hasta expiracion, y abri/cerra el Realm.

source_string: How to Play : Resource And Behavior Packs
translation: Paquilaya Juga : Resource y Behavior Pack

source_string: You can change the way that Minecraft looks and behaves using Resource and Behavior Packs.
translation: Puede cambia tu como ta mira y ta funciona el Minecraft usando Resource y Behavior Pack.

source_string: In the Settings Menu, choose a pack from the available packs list and select the plus sign next to it. Now your pack will apply its changes to the default Minecraft pack.
translation: Na Menu de Configuraciones, escoge un pack del lista de maga pack disponible y escoge el signo mas na lado. Ahora tuyo pack ay aplica el maga cambio na default pack de Minecraft.

source_string: The Server Tab will show popular Minecraft servers.
translation: El Tab de Server ay mostra maga server popular de Minecraft.

source_string: The Minecraft Marketplace is a place to find new skins, worlds, textures, and mash-up packs by various talented creators.
translation: El Marketplace de Minecraft un lugar para busca nuevo skin, mundo, texture, y mash-up pack de varios talentoso creator.

source_string: Try a new skin for a fresh new look!
translation: Prova un nuevo skin para un fresco nuevo mira!

source_string: Check out worlds to unlock new maps and challenges that you will want to play again and again!
translation: Check el maga mundo para abri nuevo mapa y desafio que quiere tu juga otra vez y otra vez!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Dale nuevo mira con tuyo viejo juego con texture pack que puede pone encima de tuyo maga mundo y Realms que ya tene!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Dale nuevo mira con tuyo viejo juego con texture pack que puede pone encima de tuyo maga mundo y Realms que ya tene!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: O prova todo con mash-up pack que curao colecciones de skin, mundo, y texture que, cuando combina, ay transforma tuyo maga mundo y Realms!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: O prova todo con mash-up pack que curao colecciones de skin, mundo, y texture que, cuando combina, ay transforma tuyo maga mundo y Realms!

source_string: Tap the Ride button while near a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Tap :_input_key.jump: to get out.
translation: Toca el boton de Ride cerca de un Carro Minero para sube y anda. Pichi :_input_key.forward: para rueda pa'adelante. Toca :_input_key.jump: para sale.

source_string: Tap the board button while near a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press them both to move forward. Tap the leave boat button to get out.
translation: Toca el boton de board cerca de un Baroto para sube. Pichi :_input_key.left: o :_input_key.right: para voltea izquierda o derecha. Pichi el dos para move pa'adelante. Toca el boton de sale baroto para sale.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: El Espada, Arco, y Tridente tene especifico encantamiento que puede consegui tu del Mesa de Encantacion o Yunque que ay mejora el daño, durabilidad y hasta enciende el mob na fuego!

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: El Tridente un arma de doble proposito, melee y de largo alcance. Presiona :_input_key.attack: para ataca. Presiona y mantene :_input_key.use: para jala el tridente para atras. Suelta :_input_key.use: para tira el tridente. El Tridente el mas mejor arma abajo del agua.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: El Tridente un arma de doble proposito, melee y de largo alcance. Toca maga mob para ataca ellos. Toca y mantene el Screen para jala el tridente para atras. Suelta el toque para tira el tridente. El Tridente el mas mejor arma abajo del agua.

source_string: %s has changed from %s skin to %s skin.
translation: Ya cambia si %s de skin de %s na skin de %s.

source_string: Want to broadcast your game? You need to have a compatible broadcasting app installed. We recommend Mixer Create as it allows you to broadcast with sub-second latency, co-stream with friends and lets your viewers interact in fun ways. Certain features like Chat and Viewer Count only work with Mixer Create.
translation: Quiere tu broadcast tuyo juego? Necesita tu tene instalao un compatible broadcasting app. Recomenda kame el Mixer Create porque permiti ese broadcast con sub-second latency, co-stream con maga amigo y permiti tuyo maga viewer interact na maga divertido manera. Algunos feature como Chat y Viewer Count funciona solamente con Mixer Create.

source_string: You do not have permission to use this feature. Please go to xbox.com and sign in to your account to fix this
translation: No hay tu permiso usa con este feature. Favor anda na xbox.com y man sign in na account de tuyo para compone con este

source_string: We need you to sign in before you can start broadcasting your game.
translation: Necesita kame que man sign in tu antes que puede principia broadcast tuyo juego.

source_string: Xforge Requests Wait for Sign In
translation: Ta Espera Sign In el Xforge Requests
Pocion de Claro Vista na Escuro

translation: Este mundo tene Behavior Pack que necesita tu download para entra y Resource Pack que puede download tu antes de entra, opcional. Cosa quiere tu download antes de entra?

source_string: This world has Behavior and Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Este mundo tene Behavior y Resource Pack que necesita tu download para entra. Quiere tu download y entra?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them before you join?
translation: Este mundo tene Resource Pack. Quiere tu download antes de entra?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Este mundo tene Resource Pack que necesita tu download para entra. Quiere tu download y entra?

source_string: Adding or removing Behavior Packs after playing a world might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Si agrega o quita tu Behavior Pack despues de juga un mundo, puede rompe el mundo y perde tu lo que ya crea tu.

source_string: Removing Behavior Packs with a plugin might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Si quita tu Behavior Pack con un plugin, puede rompe el mundo y perde tu lo que ya crea tu.

source_string: This resolution is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Este resolucion no compatible con tuyo device porque no basta el memoria de tuyo device.

translation: Incompatible este pack con tuyo device porque no sufficiente el memoria.
