translation: Abri todo %s Skin, Texture Pack, y Mundo por %s:minecoin:

source_string: Tell the creator and the community about your experience with this item!
translation: Dici con el creator y comunidad sobre tuyo experiencia con este item!

source_string: Before we can let you rate an item, you will need to sign in with Xbox Live.
translation: Antes que puede dale kame permiso para rate un item, necesita tu man sign in con Xbox Live.
Sihag Maga Filtro del Tipo de Pack

source_string: Write a description of your structure.
translation: Escribi un descripcion de tuyo structure.

source_string: Your awesome creation has been uploaded to Remix3D.com using your Remix 3D profile. You can update your profile name and image on Remix3D.com anytime.
translation: Ya upload tuyo creacion na Remix3D.com usando tuyo profile de Remix 3D. Puede actualiza tu el nombre y imagen de profile na Remix3D.com na cualquier tiempo.

source_string: New! Your Remix 3D profile is no longer linked to your Xbox Live gamertag. If you’ve already got a Remix 3D profile, we reserved your current gamertag as your name. If you’re new, we will autogenerate a Remix 3D profile for you. (You can edit it later on Remix3D.com.) Hit Agree to acknowledge this change and upload your creation to Remix3D.com. Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statements apply.
translation: Nuevo! Tuyo profile de Remix 3D no mas conectao con tuyo gamertag de Xbox Live. Si tene ya tu un profile de Remix 3D, ya reserva kame tuyo actual gamertag como tuyo nombre. Si nuevo tu, ay genera automatico kame un profile de Remix 3D para tu. (Puede edit despues na Remix3D.com.) Pichi Acepta para reconoce este cambio y upload tuyo creacion na Remix3D.com. Aplica el Microsoft Services Agreement y Privacy Statements.

source_string: You must be signed in to Xbox Live to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Necesita man sign in tu na Xbox Live para upload na Remix3D.com.

source_string: Oh no! You don't have permission to join Remix3D.com.
translation: Ay no! No tene tu permiso para entra na Remix3D.com.

source_string: Uh oh! Your model is too large. Please try uploading a smaller file.
translation: Ay! Demasiado grande tuyo model. Favor prova upload un mas pequeño file.

source_string: Oops! Your model failed to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Ay! Ya falla el upload de tuyo model na Remix3D.com.

source_string: Something went wrong. We weren't able to convert your world. You can send us your world later by going to your old world and pressing Y. Or send us your world now so we can investigate further.
translation: Ya pasa un problema. No puede convierte kame tuyo mundo. Puede manda tu con kame tuyo mundo despues con anda na tuyo mundo daan y pichi Y. O manda con kame tuyo mundo ahora para investiga kame mas.
Mal el comportamiento o falta el maga mob

source_string: Lost my items, creations, and/or player stats
translation: Ya perde mi maga item, creacion, y/o stats de jugador
No puede interact con maga item
Ya falla el conversion del mundo

source_string: By hitting Agree, you are uploading your world to the Minecraft Team. The Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statement apply.
translation: Cuando pichi tu Acepta, ta upload tu tuyo mundo na Minecraft Team. Aplica el Microsoft Services Agreement y Privacy Statement.

source_string: By uploading your World you hereby authorize Microsoft to test, reproduce, modify, distribute and publicly display your World in support of transferring your World to Minecraft.
translation: Con upload de tuyo Mundo, ta autoriza tu con Microsoft para prueba, reproduce, modifica, distribui y mostra publico tuyo Mundo para apoya el transferencia de tuyo Mundo na Minecraft.
Ta manda Mundo Daan na Minecraft...

source_string: Thank you! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it:
translation: Gracias! Ta trabaja duro kame para arregla maga cosa y no puede responde kame con tu sobre este especifico mundo. Aqui tuyo receipt que ta confirma que ya recibi kame:

source_string: It appears you don't have a license for Minecraft. Make sure you have downloaded and installed Minecraft from the store
translation: Parece que no tene tu license para Minecraft. Asegura que ya download y instala tu el Minecraft del store

source_string: When you see this icon, we are saving your game. Do not turn off your Nintendo Switch while this icon is on screen.
translation: Cuando mira tu este icon, ta salva kame tuyo juego. No apaga tuyo Nintendo Switch mientras ta na screen este icon.

source_string: Xbox Live has arrived in Minecraft! It's a gaming community for phones, PCs, and Xbox. And the best part?
translation: Ya llega el Xbox Live na Minecraft! Un comunidad de gaming para phone, PC, y Xbox. Y el mejor parte?

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: No tene tu Gamertag? Crea uno para gana maga logro, juga online con maga amigo y entra na Realms!

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: No tene tu Gamertag? Crea uno para gana maga logro, juga online con maga amigo y entra na Realms!

source_string: We tried to sign you in to your Xbox Live account, but something went wrong.
translation: Ya prova kame man sign in con tu na tuyo Xbox Live account, pero ya pasa un problema.

source_string: If you play without signing in you won't be able to see your friends list, earn achievements, join Realms, or play online on Xbox Live.
translation: Si juga tu sin man sign in, no puede mira tu tuyo lista de maga amigo, gana maga logro, entra na Realms, o juga online na Xbox Live.

source_string: Achievements and Gamerscore mark your progress through Minecraft.
translation: El Logro y Gamerscore ta marca tuyo progreso na Minecraft.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start earning them!
translation: Man sign in na Xbox Live para principia gana ellos!

source_string: Add a friend to see when they are online and to play online multiplayer without the hassle of IP addresses and ports.
translation: Agrega un amigo para mira cuando online sila y para juga multijugador online sin problema de IP address y port.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start adding friends!
translation: Man sign in na Xbox Live para principia agrega maga amigo!

source_string: Invite your friends to play online multiplayer with you without the hassle of IP address and ports.
translation: Invita tuyo maga amigo para juga multijugador online con tu sin problema de IP address y port.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start inviting friends!
translation: Man sign in na Xbox Live para principia invita maga amigo!

source_string: Servers offer some of the most creative ways to play Minecraft! We just need you to sign in so that we can make sure you have permission to play online with new people.
translation: Ta ofrece el maga server algunos del mas creativo manera para juga Minecraft! Necesita lang kame que man sign in tu para asegura kame que tene tu permiso para juga online con nuevo gente.
Ya Falla el Manda de Mundo

source_string: Thank you for sending us a copy of your world and helping us find bugs! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it: %s
translation: Gracias por manda con kame un copia de tuyo mundo y ayuda con kame busca bug! Ta trabaja duro kame para arregla maga cosa y no puede responde kame con tu sobre este especifico mundo. Aqui tuyo receipt que ta confirma que ya recibi kame: %s

source_string: Oops! We weren't able to receive your world. Try checking your internet connection or sending it again later.
translation: Ay no! No puede recibi kame tuyo mundo. Prova check tuyo conexion de internet o manda otra vez despues.

source_string: Did your old world not look or work the way it should have? Send us your world and help us find the bugs!
translation: No ya mira o funciona tuyo mundo daan como debe? Manda con kame tuyo mundo y ayuda con kame busca el bug!

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Puede cambia tu el mira de tuyo personaje con un Skin Pack del Store. Escoge 'Store' na Menu Principal para mira que disponible.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Ay pelea por contigo el maga golem de fierro!

source_string: Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: Cambia el configuraciones de brillo para hace mas claro o mas oscuro el juego.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: Si pone tu el dificultad del juego na Peaceful, ay regenera automatico tuyo salud, y no ay sale monstruo na noche!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Dale hueso na lobo para hace manso. Despues puede tu hace sentao o sigui contigo.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Si usa tu calabaza na cabeza, no ay ataca contigo el maga Enderman.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: Si duerme na cama na noche, ay avanza el juego hasta amanecer, pero todo el jugador na juego multijugador necesita duerme na cama na mismo tiempo.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Cosecha comida de puerco, baca, oveja, conejo, y manok. Cocina y come para recupera salud!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Cosecha cuero de maga baca, y usa para hace armadura y maga libro.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: Si tene tu un balde vacio, puede llena tu con agua, lava, o leche de baca!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Usa azada para prepara maga area del suelo para siembra.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: No ay ataca el araña con tu durante el dia - menos que ataca tu con ellos.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Si dale come tu un animal, no ay despawn. Construi un corral para guarda seguro tuyo maga animal.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: El comida cocido ta reduce mejor el hambre que el comida hilaw.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Hace antorcha para ilumina el maga lugar oscuro. Ta esconde el maga monstruo na oscuridad!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Llega mas rapido na destino con carro minero y riel!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Siembra poco sapling y ay crece como arbol.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: El maga Pigmen no ay ataca con tu, solamente si ya ataca tu con ellos.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Puede cambia el punto de espawn de tuyo juego y salta hasta el amanecer si ta duerme na cama.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Golpea otra vez el maga fireball na Ghast!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: Si hace tu un portal, puede viaja tu na otro dimension - el Nether.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Usa el herramienta correcto! Mas rapido cava tierra con pala que con pico!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: Si no hay carbon para el antorcha de tuyo, puede siempre hace carbon de palo na horno.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: Hende bueno idea cava derecho abajo o derecho arriba.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: El Polvo de Hueso (hacido de hueso de Esqueleto) puede usa como abono y hace crece las cosas al instante!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
translation: Ta explota el maga Creeper cuando ta acerca con tu!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Ta crea Obsidiana cuando el agua ta toca con bloque de fuente de lava.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Si quita el source block del agua o lava, ay para completo el flujo.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: El Escombro resistente na fireball del Ghast, util para guarda maga portal.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: El maga bloque que puede usa como fuente de luz ay derrite nieve y hielo. Incluido el maga antorcha, piedrarde y Jack-O-Lantern.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Cuidao cuando construi maga estructura de lana na abierto, porque el rayo de tormenta puede quema el lana.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Un balde de lava puede usa na horno para funde 100 bloque.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: El instrumento que ta toca el bloque de nota depende del material debajo.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: El maga Zombi y Esqueleto puede sobrevivi na luz del dia si ta na agua o ta usa casco.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: Si ataca tu un lobo, todo el maga lobo na cerca ay hace hostil y ay ataca con tu. Asi tambien el maga Zombie Pigmen.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: El maga lobo y Golem de Fierro hende ta ataca con el maga Creeper.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: El maga gallina ta pone un huevo cada 5 hasta 10 minuto.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: El Obsidiana puede lang mina con pico de diamante.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: El maga creeper el mas facil fuente de polvora.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Si pone tu dos baul lado por lado ay hace un baul grande.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: El maga lobo manso ta mostra su salud con posicion de su cola. Dale carne para sana.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Puede hace diferente colorao tina de varios material, cocina cactus na horno para recibi Tina Verde!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: Na maga mobile device, puede download el pack "Musica de Minecraft" na categoria de Musica na Store de Minecraft.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Algunos animal ay sigui contigo si tiene tu trigo na mano.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Tiene un update para este juego eventualmente!

source_string: Mojang has more awards than staff!
translation: Mas premio el de Mojang que empleao!
Hay maga famoso que ta juga Minecraft!

source_string: Do not look directly at the bugs.
translation: No mira directamente con el maga bug.

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Ya nace el maga creeper de un coding bug.

source_string: Is it a chicken or is it a duck?

translation: Ya ta ba tu na MINECON?

source_string: No-one at Mojang has ever seen Junkboy's face.
translation: Nunca nadie na Mojang ya mira el cara de Junkboy.

source_string: Did you know there's a Minecraft Wiki?
translation: Sabe ba tu que hay Wiki de Minecraft?

source_string: MINECON 2011 was in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!
translation: El MINECON 2011 ya hace na Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!
El MINECON 2012 ya hace na Paris, Francia!

source_string: MINECON 2013 was in Orlando, Florida, USA!
translation: El MINECON 2013 ya hace na Orlando, Florida, USA!

source_string: No-one can remember where MINECON 2014 was held.
translation: Nadie ta acuerda onde ya hace el MINECON 2014.
El MINECON 2015 ya hace na Londres, UK!

source_string: MINECON 2016 was in Anaheim, California, USA!
translation: El MINECON 2016 ya hace na Anaheim, California, USA!

source_string: Always assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
translation: Siempre pensa que falso el maga chisme, hende que berdad!

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: Ya crea el primero version del Minecraft na 6 dia lang!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: El idioma del Enderman gayot English na reverso.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: El original nombre del Minecraft Cave Game.

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become Zombie Pigmen!
translation: El maga puerco que ya golpea de rayo ta hace Zombie Pigmen!
Ta odia el maga Enderman el hora de baño!

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: A veces el maga golem de fierro ta dale flor na maga bata del barrio!

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: Un Spider Jockey el raro aparicion de un Gagamba montao por un esqueleto!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the overworld.
translation: Viaja un bloque na Nether, igual con viaja ocho bloque na Supramundo.

source_string: You need an Agent to code! Get an Agent egg from your creative inventory.
translation: Necesita tu un Agente para code! Coje un huevo de Agente de tuyo inventario creativo.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to sync your Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Man sign in na Xbox Live para sync el maga Skin, Pack de Textura, Mundo y Mash-up de tuyo. Ay ta ahi ese para con tu na cualquier device onde ta juga tu Minecraft.
Ya Sync el maga Compra na Xbox Live

source_string: Syncing purchases to Xbox Live account...
translation: Ta sync el maga compra na Xbox Live account...

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not sync this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Si hende sync el maga compra de este device con este Xbox Live account, hende ay hace primario este account para este device. Hende ay man sign in automaticamente cuando principia Minecraft.

source_string: Your app store purchases will be available wherever you log in with %s. You can only sync these packs to one account, but they will continue to be available to anyone who uses this device.
translation: El maga compra de tuyo app store ay disponible onde man sign in tu con %s. Solo na un account puede sync este maga pack, pero ay queda disponible para todo el que ta usa este device.

source_string: Is this the account that you would like to use to access your previous purchases?
translation: Este ba el account que quiere usa para acceso el maga compra anterior de tuyo?

source_string: You can't extend your Realm right now. We have now introduced subscriptions for Realms on Xbox and you can buy a new subscription as soon as your Realm has expired in %d days. But don't worry! We will give you 14 extra days for free and your Realm will be kept online, so you will have plenty of time to extend it by then.
translation: Hende puede extende tu Realm ahora. Ya introduci kame el maga suscripcion para Realms na Xbox y puede compra tu nuevo suscripcion cuando ya expira el Realm de tuyo na %d dia. Pero no preocupa! Ay da kame con tu 14 dia extra gratis y ay queda online el Realm de tuyo, asi mucho tiempo tene tu para extende hasta entonces.

source_string: How to Play : Education Edition Blocks
translation: Como Juga : Maga Bloque de Education Edition

source_string: Minecraft: Education Edition features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. World Builder ability negates the restrictions of these blocks.
translation: Minecraft: Education Edition tiene varios bloque especial que ta hace mas facil para el maga maestro crea y usa de leccion. El habilidad de Plantador de Mundo ta quita el maga restriccion de estos bloque.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks focus where players can build in a world.
translation: El maga bloque de Permiti y Nega ta controla onde puede construi el maga jugador na mundo.

source_string: Allow blocks let players place or destroy blocks in the area above them.
translation: El maga bloque de Permiti ta deja el maga jugador pone o destrui bloque na area arriba de ellos.

source_string: Deny blocks prohibit users from placing or destroying blocks in the area above them.
translation: El maga bloque de Nega ta prohibi el maga jugador pone o destrui bloque na area arriba de ellos.

source_string: Neither block affects the area below them.
translation: Ningun bloque ta afecta el area abajo de ellos.

source_string: If an Allow block is placed somewhere with a Deny block below it, the space between the two blocks will be protected while the space above the Allow block will permit users to place and destroy blocks.
translation: Si pone un bloque de Permiti onde tiene bloque de Nega abajo, protegido el espacio entre los dos bloque, mientras el espacio arriba del bloque de Permiti ay deja el maga jugador pone y destrui bloque.

source_string: Border Blocks are bright, red walls that act like a force field, extending upwards and downwards forever!
translation: El maga Bloque de Borde, maga pader rojo y brillante que ta actua como campo de fuerza, ta extende arriba y abajo para siempre!

source_string: Border blocks prevent players from passing through, over, or under them by any means other than being a World Builder.

source_string: What happens to my Realms and worlds when my subscription to Realms Plus ends?
translation: Que ay pasa con Realms y mundo de yo cuando ya acaba el suscripcion de Realms Plus?

source_string: If your subscription ends, you and your friends will no longer be able to play online together on Realms, and you will no longer have access to the packs or cloud storage. You will be able to purchase and download any world templates saved to your Realm and cloud storage within 18 months of ending your subscription unless they are no longer offered by Minecraft. If you used Realms Plus worlds, texture packs, or mash-ups, you will need to purchase those packs in the store or, if those packs are still in Realms Plus, re-subscribe, to play those world templates.

Si ya usa tu mundo, pack de textura o mash-up de Realms Plus, necesita compra ese maga pack na store o, si na Realms Plus pa ese maga pack, suscribi otra vez, para juga ese maga plantilla de mundo.

source_string: You need a Nintendo Switch Online membership to vote in Minecraft. Please vote on the web: aka.ms/MobVote
translation: Necesita tu membresia de Nintendo Switch Online para vota na Minecraft. Favor vota na web: aka.ms/MobVote

source_string: You need to be signed-in to the "PlayStation Network" to vote in Minecraft. Please sign in or vote on the web: aka.ms/MobVote
translation: Necesita tu man sign in na "PlayStation Network" para vota na Minecraft. Favor man sign in o vota na web: aka.ms/MobVote

source_string: Help us test out the voting server for the Minecraft Live 2022 Mob Vote! If you joined the vote during Minecraft Now's August episode, you will already be familiar with the server. We invite all of you to come for the vote, and stay for the mini-games!
translation: Ayuda contigo kame proba el server de votacion para el Mob Vote de Minecraft Live 2022! Si ya entra tu na votacion durante el episodio de Agosto de Minecraft Now, conoce ya tu el server. Invita kame con todo ustedes para vene para vota, y queda para el mini-juego!

source_string: Unfortunately we could not connect. Please try again later.
translation: Lastima, no ya puede conecta kame. Favor proba otra vez despues.

source_string: Touch and drag along the screen to look around.
translation: Toca y arrastra na screen para mira alrededor.

source_string: Press :tip_virtual_button_sprint: to toggle sprint. You will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Pichi :tip_virtual_button_sprint: para alterna el sprint. Ay sigue corre hasta que tiene tu menos de :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Press :touch_forward: twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :touch_forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Pichi :touch_forward: dos vez rapido para sprint. Mientras ta sostene tu :touch_forward:, ay continua tu sprint hasta que menos de :shank::shank::shank: el tuyo.

source_string: Press :tip_virtual_button_sprint: to toggle sprint. You will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Pichi :tip_virtual_button_sprint: para alterna el sprint. Ay sigue corre hasta que tiene tu menos de :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Tap and hold a block to mine it with your hand or the item you're holding. You may need to craft specific tools before you can mine certain blocks.
translation: Toca y pichi tarda ka bloque para mina con mano o con item que ta agarra tu. Puede necesita hace herramienta especifico antes de puede mina ciertos bloque.

source_string: Tap and hold a block to mine it with your hand or the item you're holding. You may need to craft specific tools before you can mine certain blocks.
translation: Toca y pichi tarda ka bloque para mina con mano o con item que ta agarra tu. Puede necesita hace herramienta especifico antes de puede mina ciertos bloque.

source_string: Tap and drag your finger anywhere to aim with :tip_crosshair: and highlight a block. Tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy: to mine it with your hand or the item you're holding. You might need to craft specific tools before you can mine certain blocks.
translation: Toca y arrastra el dedo na cualquier lugar para apunta con :tip_crosshair: y resalta ka bloque. Toca y pichi tarda :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy: para mina con mano o con item que ta agarra tu. Puede necesita hace herramienta especifico antes de puede mina ciertos bloque.

source_string: If you're holding an item, tap the screen to use it or tap and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it. Tap and hold the screen to eat any food you're holding.
translation: Si ta agarra tu ka item, toca el screen para usa o toca y pichi tarda el item na hotbar para tira. Toca y pichi tarda el screen para come cualquier comida que ta agarra tu.

source_string: If you're holding an item, tap the screen to use it or tap and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it. Tap and hold the screen to eat any food you're holding.
translation: Si ta agarra tu ka item, toca el screen para usa o toca y pichi tarda el item na hotbar para tira. Toca y pichi tarda el screen para come cualquier comida que ta agarra tu.

source_string: If you're holding an item, tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to use that item or touch and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it. Tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to eat a food item you're holding.
translation: Si ta agarra tu ka item, toca :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: para usa ese item o toca y pichi tarda el item na hotbar para tira. Toca y pichi tarda :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: para come ka comida que ta agarra tu.

source_string: Sneaking keeps you from falling off blocks, hides you from mobs, and hides your nametag from other players. To sneak, tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak:.
translation: Con agacha, hende ta cae tu del bloque, ta esconde contigo de maga mob, y ta esconde el nametag de tuyo de otro jugador. Para agacha, toca :tip_virtual_button_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking keeps you from falling off blocks, hides you from mobs, and hides your nametag from other players. To sneak, tap :touch_sneak:.
translation: Con agacha, hende ta cae tu del bloque, ta esconde contigo de maga mob, y ta esconde el nametag de tuyo de otro jugador. Para agacha, toca :touch_sneak:.

source_string: Sneaking keeps you from falling off blocks, hides you from mobs, and hides your nametag from other players. To sneak, tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak:.
translation: Con agacha, hende ta cae tu del bloque, ta esconde contigo de maga mob, y ta esconde el nametag de tuyo de otro jugador. Para agacha, toca :tip_virtual_button_sneak:.

source_string: If you lose health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will automatically replenish. Eating food will also replenish your :shank:.
translation: Si perde tu salud pero tiene pa al menos nueve :shank:, ay recupera automaticamente el salud de tuyo. Ta recupera tambien el :shank: si come.

source_string: Your health will automatically replenish if you have at least nine :shank:. Your :shank: will slowly decrease as you explore and get hungry, but eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: Ay recupera automaticamente el salud de tuyo si tiene al menos nueve :shank:. Ay baja poco-poco el :shank: de tuyo mientras ta explora y ta tiene hambre, pero si come, ay recupera el :shank:.

source_string: To eat something, tap the food item on your hotbar, then tap and hold the screen to eat.
translation: Para come, toca el comida na hotbar, despues toca y pichi tarda el screen para come.

source_string: If you use Action Buttons, first tap the food item on your hotbar, then tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to eat it.
translation: Si ta usa Action Button, primero toca el comida na hotbar, despues toca y pichi tarda :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: para come.

source_string: Certain activities will make you more hungry faster, like sprinting. Fortunately, some foods are more nourishing and will fill up more :shank:.
translation: Ciertos actividad ta hace mas rapido el hambre, como el sprint. Por suerte, algunos comida mas nutritivo y ta llena mas :shank:.

source_string: If you have full :shank:, the last food you ate will apply a saturation value - a hidden value that gives an extra boost to your hunger level.
translation: Si lleno el :shank: de tuyo, el ultimo comida que ya come ay aplica ka valor de saturacion - un valor escondido que ta da extra refuerzo na nivel de hambre.

source_string: If you tap on a stack of items, you'll automatically select all items in the stack. You can move the stack the same way you would a single item.
translation: Si toca ka monton de item, ay selecciona automaticamente todo el item na monton. Puede move el monton igual como ka item solo.

source_string: To split a stack of items, tap and hold on the item stack until the selection slider appears. Without releasing the screen, slide your finger left and right to select the number of items you want to remove from the stack.
translation: Para divide ka monton de item, toca y pichi tarda na monton hasta que sale el slider de seleccion. Sin suelta el screen, desliza el dedo izquierda y derecha para selecciona cuanto item quiere quita del monton.

source_string: For more information, please visit https://aka.ms/MinecraftGeoSunsetting in any web browser.
translation: Para mas informacion, favor visita https://aka.ms/MinecraftGeoSunsetting na cualquier web browser.

source_string: Our ability to support this device is coming to an end in your area. After you receive the final update, you will still be able to play on your worlds, and access your Marketplace purchases, but you will no longer be able to make purchases in the Marketplace. Realms managed from this device will continue to work for 6 months. On Sept. 30th, 2023 you will no longer have access to the realm. It is recommended you download your world prior to this and cancel your subscription by viewing your Subscriptions settings on your device. %sIf you have signed in with a Microsoft/Xbox Live account, your Marketplace purchases & Minecoins and your Realms subscription will be available on other platforms. If you would like to move your worlds from this device to another device, you can do so by uploading the world to a Realm, and downloading a backup onto your new device. %sClick on the button for more information, including ways to move your world to a new device.
translation: Ta acaba ya nuestro capacidad para soporta este device na area de tuyo. Despues que recibi el ultimo update, puede pa gihapon juga na maga mundo de tuyo y acceso na maga compra de Marketplace, pero hende ya puede hace compra na Marketplace. Ay sigue funciona por 6 mes el maga Realm manejao de este device. Na Sept. 30, 2023 hende ya tiene tu acceso na realm. Recomienda kame que download el mundo de tuyo antes de ese y cancela el suscripcion de tuyo con mira el configuraciones de Suscripcion na device de tuyo. %sSi ya man sign in tu con Microsoft/Xbox Live account, disponible na otro platform el maga compra de Marketplace & Minecoins y el suscripcion de Realms de tuyo. Si quiere move el maga mundo de este device na otro device, puede hace con upload del mundo na Realm, y download ka backup na nuevo device. %sPichi el boton para mas informacion, incluido como move el mundo de tuyo na nuevo device.

source_string: Allow players to sneak under 1.5 block gaps
translation: Manda el maga jugador agacha abajo de espacio de 1.5 bloque

source_string: You can't change this setting while playing in a world
translation: Hende puede cambia este configuracion mientras ta juga na mundo

source_string: Looks like you've been busy reporting other players. Thank you for helping us make Minecraft a safe and welcoming place. Keep in mind, filing false reports is against our Community Standards.
translation: Parece que ocupao tu na reporta otro jugador. Gracias por ayuda contigo kame hace de Minecraft un lugar seguro y acogedor. Acuerda que contra el Estandar de Comunidad el hace de falso reporte.

source_string: %s is a friend of yours. Are you sure you want to report them? Filing false reports is against our Community Standards.
translation: Amigo de tuyo si %s. Seguro ba tu que quiere reporta con ellos? Contra el Estandar de Comunidad el hace de falso reporte.

source_string: Need more smithing templates? Try to copy them.
translation: Necesita mas Plantilla de Herreria? Proba copia ellos.

source_string: The sniffer egg seems to like moss blocks.
translation: Dol quiere-quiere el huevos de esnifador esta encima de bloque de lumut.

source_string: Mob heads make sounds, try them out on note blocks!
translation: El maga cabeza de mob ta hace sonido, proba ellos na noteblock!

source_string: Some sand might be suspicious. Use your brush on it to find some good stuff!
translation: Puede ser sospechoso ka arena. Usa el brush de tuyo na ello para busca cosa bueno!

source_string: Two players can ride together on a camel.
translation: Dos jugador puede monta junto na camello.
El maga camello ta brinca... horizontalmente!

source_string: §4You have been sent a warning. Your behavior may be found offensive by other players. Please be mindful of others you are playing with.
translation: §4Ya manda contigo ka advertencia. Puede ofensivo el comportamiento de tuyo para otro jugador. Favor ten cuidao con otro con quien ta juga tu.

source_string: Minecraft is for everyone! Please be sure to conduct yourself according to our community standards.
translation: Minecraft ay para todo! Favor asegura que ta comporta tu segun nuestro estandar de comunidad.

source_string: Could not find player. Please select a valid player.
translation: Hende ya encontra el jugador. Favor selecciona ka jugador valido.

source_string: Sends a warn message to player.
translation: Ta manda ka mensaje de advertencia na jugador.

source_string: You are unable to use the marketplace until your suspension expires.
translation: Hende puede usa el marketplace hasta que acaba el suspension de tuyo.

source_string: Disabling this option can potentially increase FPS, but may cause screen tearing
translation: Si apaga este opcion, puede aumenta el FPS, pero puede causa screen tearing

source_string: Our ability to support this device is coming to an end. You will continue to receive updates until Feb. of 2024, when you will receive your final update for this device.%sAfter you receive the final update, you will still be able to play on your worlds, and access Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins), however you will no longer be able to make new purchases on this device. Realms managed from this device will continue to work for 6 months unless they are updated by the Realm owner on a different device. To cancel your realm subscription, you will need to do so in the Settings menu for Subscriptions on the device the Realm was created from. You will no longer receive the latest updates and will be unable to play multiplayer with devices or Realms which are continuing to receive updates. You will also not be able to connect to certain servers.%sClick on the button for more information, including ways to move your world to a new device.
translation: Ta acaba ya nuestro capacidad para soporta este device. Ay recibi pa tu update hasta Feb. de 2024, y despues ay recibi tu el ultimo update para este device.%sDespues que recibi el ultimo update, puede pa gihapon juga na maga mundo de tuyo y acceso na maga compra de Marketplace (incluido Minecoins), pero hende ya puede hace nuevo compra na este device. source_string: The composition of particles in a body of water is what determines its color and how light behaves as it travels through the water. There are 3 types of particles: CDOM, Chlorophyll, and Suspended Sediment
translation: El composicion del maga particula na un cuerpo de agua el que ta determina su color y como ta comporta el luz cuando ta pasa na agua. Hay 3 tipo de particula: CDOM, Chlorophyll, y Suspended Sediment

source_string: High concentrations of chlorophyll produces green colors, due to chlorophyll strongly absorbing blue and red wavelengths
translation: El alto concentracion de chlorophyll ta produci color verde, porque el chlorophyll ta absorbe fuerte el longitud de onda azul y rojo

source_string: High concentrations of suspended sediment produces red to red-brown colors, due to suspended sediment strongly absorbing blue and green wavelengths
translation: El alto concentracion de suspended sediment ta produci color rojo hasta rojo-moreno, porque el suspended sediment ta absorbe fuerte el longitud de onda azul y verde

source_string: (Chromophoric Dissolved Organic Matter) High concentrations of CDOM produces yellow to yellow-brown colors, due to CDOM strongly absorbing blue wavelengths
translation: (Chromophoric Dissolved Organic Matter) El alto concentracion de CDOM ta produci color amarillo hasta amarillo-moreno, porque el CDOM ta absorbe fuerte el longitud de onda azul

source_string: Caustics allow for the projecting light rays on underwater surfaces
translation: El Caustics ta permiti proyecta maga rayo de luz na maga superficie debajo del agua

source_string: Frame Length The number of seconds to spend on a single frame of animation in the caustics sprite sheet texture. A larger value will result in a slower animation, while smaller values will result in a faster animation
translation: Frame Length El numero de segundo que ta gasta na un solo frame de animacion na textura del sprite sheet de caustics. Un valor mas grande ay hace mas lento el animacion, mientras un valor mas chico ay hace mas rapido

source_string: Specifies a texture to use for the caustics animation
translation: Especifica un textura para usa na animacion de caustics

source_string: Controls the size of the caustics texture when it is projected on the world. This value scales inversely in that, a larger value means that the texture will appear smaller, repeating/tiling more, whereas a smaller value will cause the texture to appear bigger, covering a larger area of the world
translation: Controla el grandor del textura de caustics cuando ta proyecta na mundo. Este valor ta escala al reves, un valor mas grande significa que el textura ay parece mas chico y mas ta repeti, mientras un valor mas chico ay hace el textura parece mas grande y ta cubri mas area del mundo

source_string: Controls how bright the caustics effect appears. A larger value will increase the brightness/intensity
translation: Controla que tan claro ta parece el efecto de caustics. Un valor mas grande ay aumenta el claridad/intensidad

source_string: Waves are an optional effect that can be used to complement water surface animations to make your water appear more realistic. They can be configured to blend with existing water texture animations or replace them entirely
translation: El Waves un efecto opcional que puede usa para complementa el animacion de superficie del agua para hace mas realista el tuyo agua. Puede configura para mezcla con el animacion de textura del agua existente o reemplaza completamente

source_string: Determines how many waves there are per water block. Larger values will create more tightly packed waves, whereas smaller values will spread waves out over a wider area
translation: Determina cuantos onda hay por bloque de agua. Un valor mas grande ay hace maga onda mas apretao, mientras un valor mas chico ay extende el maga onda na area mas ancho

source_string: Determines how many different layers of waves to simulate. Larger values will produce more complex waves
translation: Determina cuantos capa diferente de onda ay simula. Un valor mas grande ay produci maga onda mas complejo

source_string: Determines how much waves displace the water surface. Larger values will result in deeper waves, whereas smaller values will produce shallower waves
translation: Determina cuanto el maga onda ta desplaza el superficie del agua. Un valor mas grande ay resulta na maga onda mas hondo, mientras un valor mas chico ay produci maga onda mas bajo

source_string: Controls the overall resolution of the fractal effect. A value of 1 represents the lowest resolution, resulting in smoother waves, while values less than 1 produce more chaotic waves
translation: Controla el resolucion general del efecto fractal. Un valor de 1 representa el resolucion mas bajo, con resultado de maga onda mas suave, mientras maga valor menor que 1 ta produci maga onda mas caotico

source_string: Determines the movement speed of the first wave and the starting value of the Speed Scaling parameter
translation: Determina el velocidad de movimiento del primero onda y el valor inicial del parametro Speed Scaling

source_string: Adjusts the core shape of waves. A value of 1 results in a pure sine wave, whereas values larger than 1 will produce sharper waves
translation: Ajusta el forma central del maga onda. Un valor de 1 resulta na onda sine puro, mientras maga valor mas grande que 1 ay produci maga onda mas agudo

source_string: Controls how much smaller waves are pulled into larger waves. A value of 0 results in no pull. Values larger than 0 will pull waves in a standard concave fashion, whereas values less than 0 will pull waves in a convex fashion, resulting in more pillowing waves as opposed to cresting waves
translation: Controla cuanto el maga onda mas chico ta jala adentro del maga onda mas grande. Un valor de 0 no hay jala. Maga valor mas grande que 0 ay jala el maga onda na manera concavo estandar, mientras maga valor menor que 0 ay jala el maga onda na manera convexo, con resultado de maga onda mas almohadao en vez de maga onda con cresta

translation: Asignacion de Data de Bioma - Asigna metadata de bioma na un seleccion, incluyendo adentro de Dimension Personalizao. Ta afecta maga sistema como clima, regla de espawneada, y Vibrant Visuals pero no ta pone o cambia maga bloque.

source_string: Vibrant Visuals: Biome Config Mapping - Easily mix and match Vibrant Visual settings across multiple biomes using the new config mapping window. Find it in the Vibrant Visuals panel: [~*icon|$val=pack://textures/editor/Vibrant-Visuals.png~]
translation: Vibrant Visuals: Mapeo de Config de Bioma - Facil mezcla maga configuraciones de Vibrant Visual na varios bioma usando el ventana nuevo de mapeo de config. Encontra na panel de Vibrant Visuals: [~*icon|$val=pack://textures/editor/Vibrant-Visuals.png~]

source_string: Cursor improvements - We've added contextual cursors to improve feedback. You should now see a "loading" icon when you're blocked from taking action by something that requires processing time, such as chunk regeneration or placing a very large primitive shape.
translation: Mejora del cursor - Ya agrega kame maga cursor contextual para mejora el feedback. Ay mira tu ahora un icono de "carga" cuando tu ta bloquea de hace accion por algo que necesita hora para procesa, como regeneracion de chunk o pone un forma primitivo muy grande.

source_string: %s Use "Import Custom Mesh" to choose a 3D mesh on your hard drive that you've downloaded or exported from a modeling program.%s You can move, rotate and scale the mesh preview in your world using the viewport widget and the sliders in the tool panel.%s "Place Blocks" will turn your mesh into a shell of blocks using your active hotbar selection.%s "Cancel" will clear the loaded mesh
translation: %s Usa "Importa Mesh Personalizao" para escoge un mesh 3D na tuyo hard drive que ya download o exporta tu de un programa de modelado.%s Puede tu mueve, gira y cambia el escala del preview de mesh na tuyo mundo usando el widget de viewport y el slider na panel de herramienta.%s "Pone Bloque" ay converti tuyo mesh na un cascara de maga bloque usando tuyo seleccion activo de hotbar.%s "Cancela" ay sihag el mesh carga.

source_string: %s Add your own Custom Dimensions with the "Add Custom Dimension" button.%s Dimension names must include a namespace, such as "namespace:mydimension".%s Click on any dimension in the list to visit it and start placing blocks. You can also find them in the World/Dimensions menu.%s Custom dimensions cannot currently be renamed or deleted.
translation: %s Agrega tuyo propio Dimension Personalizao con el boton "Agrega Dimension Personalizao".%s El nombre de dimension debe inclui un namespace, como "namespace:mydimension".%s Pichi cualquier dimension na lista para visita y principia pone maga bloque. Puede tu encontra tamen na menu de Mundo/Dimension.%s El maga dimension personalizao no puede pa renombra o borra por ahora.

source_string: %s Biome Data Assignment lets you assign a selection to the biome of your choice.%s This does not add or change any blocks, but will affect game systems like vegetation tint, mob spawning, Vibrant Visuals, and weather.%s Choose a biome in the "Biome to Assign" box, and use the "Assign Biome to Selection" to reassign data.
translation: %s Con Asignacion de Data de Bioma, puede tu asigna un seleccion na bioma de tuyo escoge.%s Esto no ta agrega o cambia ningun bloque, pero ta afecta maga sistema del juego como tinte de vegetacion, espawneada de mob, Vibrant Visuals, y clima.%s Escoge un bioma na caja de "Data de Bioma para Asigna", y usa el "Asigna Data de Bioma na Seleccion" para reasigna el data.

source_string: %s You'll be reassigning a selection in the world. Within the Biome Data Assignment panel, you can use additional settings to determine how the data reassignment will interact with that selection.%s "Extend up to world ceiling" and "Extend down to world floor" will extend the effect on the Y axis, including all blocks above or below your selection respectively.%s Masking your selection by Biomes or Biome Tags will use existing Biome boundaries to restrict the effect further. These settings will not extend data assignment beyond your selection, but can provide further control.%s By default, the list of available biomes and tags will be filtered to show only valid options within your existing selection. Uncheck "Only show biomes/tags within the active selection" to see the full list.
translation: %s Ta reasigna tu un seleccion na mundo. Adentro del panel de Asignacion de Data de Bioma, puede tu usa maga configuraciones adicional para determina como el reasignacion de data ay interactua con ese seleccion.%s "Extende hasta el techo del mundo" y "Extende hasta el suelo del mundo" ay extende el efecto na eje Y, incluyendo todo bloque arriba o abajo de tuyo seleccion.%s Si tu mask el seleccion por Bioma o Biome Tag, ay usa el limite de bioma existente para restringi mas el efecto. Este configuraciones no ay extende el asignacion de data mas alla de tuyo seleccion, pero puede dale mas control.%s Por defecto, el lista de bioma y tag disponible ta filtra para mostra lang maga opcion valido adentro de tuyo seleccion existente. Quita el check de "Mostra lang maga bioma/tag adentro del seleccion activo" para mira el lista completo.

source_string: %s Any areas you've already reassigned will be listed here. Each item shows you the region's current biome assignment, its rough center (in X and Z), and the full height in Y, so you can determine whether the affected area extends to the world ceiling or floor.%s Use %s to move your camera to that location.%s Use %s to change the assignment of that area to another biome.%s It is not currently possible to revert a reassigned area to the world's original state.
translation: %s Todo area que ya reasigna tu ay lista aqui. Cada item ta mostra el asignacion de bioma actual del region, su centro aproximao (na X y Z), y el altor completo na Y, para sabe tu si el area afectao ta extende hasta el techo o suelo del mundo.%s Usa %s para mueve tuyo camara na ese lugar.%s Usa %s para cambia el asignacion de ese area na otro bioma.%s Por ahora no puede revierte un area reasignao al estado original del mundo.
Vibrant Visuals: Mapeo de Config de Bioma

source_string: When filling biomes, if any of the selected positions are in regions that have an assigned biome that is eligible for replacement but the position itself is not (due to the above filters), reassign those regions to a biome in this list instead of filling them with the selected biome. Using live metrics you can know how to tune your settings proactively for smoother gameplay and the experience you want for your community.

Algun proceso intenso na Minecraft puede afecta el gameplay, hasta na el mas poderoso server. source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, press :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, push :_gamepad_stick_left:/:_gamepad_stick_right: forward twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can hold down :_input_key.jump: to move up and :_input_key.sneak: to move down.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Use the cursor to select an item and press :_gamepad_bumper_right:/:_gamepad_bumper_left:. Then, move your cursor to an empty item slot and press again to drop the item.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Boat to board it. Push :_gamepad_stick_left:/:_gamepad_stick_right: left or right to turn. Push :_gamepad_stick_left:/:_gamepad_stick_right: forward to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.

source_string: Add Guide Planes for precise raycasting, especially in the sky or in a void. Find the Guide Planes panel on your action bar.

source_string: Guide planes create a temporary surface that other tools can use for drawing and placement.%sThis makes it easier to place blocks in mid-air, especially in void dimensions.
translation: El maga guide plane ta hace un superficie temporal que puede usa el otro herramienta para dibuja y pone.%sCon esto, mas facil pone bloque na aire, especialmente na maga dimension vacio.

source_string: Use the Guide Planes panel to create and manage existing guide planes.%sCustomize their name and color, adjust the grid density, and show/hide guide planes to manage clutter. Hidden guide planes will not affect other tools.
translation: Usa el panel de Guide Plane para crea y administra el maga guide plane que existe ya.%sPersonaliza el nombre y color, ajusta el densidad del grid, y mostra o esconde el maga guide plane para no estorba. El maga guide plane escondido no ay afecta el otro herramienta.

source_string: The Annotation Tool lets you leave notes in the world such as to-do lists, playtest feedback, or rough sketches and templates for you or your team to use later.
translation: El Herramienta de Anotacion ta deja con tu hace nota na mundo como lista de hacer, comento del playtest, o maga boceto y plantilla para usa tu o tuyo equipo despues.

source_string: Use the Place %s mode to add new annotations of several types.
translation: Usa el modo de Pone %s para agrega maga anotacion nuevo de varios tipo.

source_string: A drawing annotation is a freehand line drawn directly onto solid blocks in the world. In Edit mode, you can add or remove line segments for more nuanced control.
translation: Un anotacion de dibujo es un linea dibujao na mano directo encima del bloque solido na mundo. Na modo de Edit, puede agrega o quita segmento de linea para mas control.

source_string: A comment is similar to a text annotation, but it appears in the world. You can place it in Crosshair mode or Test World, and it will persist when you return to the Editor.
translation: Un comento parecido con un anotacion de texto, pero ta aparece na mundo. Puede pone na Modo de Mira o na Mundo de Test, y ay queda cuando vira tu na Editor.

source_string: Whether or not the annotation faces the camera or remains fixed.
translation: Si el anotacion ta mira na camera o queda fijo.
Mostra Texto del Cuerpo na Mundo

source_string: Show the annotation body text in the world.
translation: Mostra el texto del cuerpo del anotacion na mundo.
Mostra Texto del Cuerpo na Mundo

source_string: Show the annotation title in the world.
translation: Mostra el title del anotacion na mundo.

source_string: The color of the annotation title in the world.
translation: El color del title del anotacion na mundo.

source_string: The font size of the annotation's title.
translation: El grandor de letra del title del anotacion.

source_string: The maximum width of the text annotation, in blocks. After this width limit, text will wrap.
translation: El maximo anchor del anotacion de texto, na maga bloque. Despues de este limite de anchor, el texto ta sigue na otro linea.

source_string: The body of the annotation. Maximum 32,500 characters.
translation: El cuerpo del anotacion. Maximo 32,500 caracter.

source_string: The title of the visible annotation, and its name in the Management Panel. Maximum 256 characters.
translation: El title del anotacion visible, y su nombre na Panel de Administracion. Maximo 256 caracter.

source_string: Choose how the cursor targets and moves.
translation: Escoge como el cursor ta apunta y ta mueve.

source_string: Choose between a collision point and a fixed cursor position. Use %s to toggle cursor mode.
translation: Escoge entre un punto de colision y un posicion fijo del cursor. Usa %s para alterna el modo de cursor.

source_string: Set the cursor distance from the player. Use Shift+mouse wheel to adjust the distance.
translation: Pone el distancia del cursor desde el jugador. Usa Shift+rueda del mouse para ajusta el distancia.

source_string: Target the block adjacent to the face under the cursor.
translation: Apunta el bloque junto na cara debajo del cursor.

source_string: Offset the cursor position in world space.
translation: Offset del posicion del cursor na espacio del mundo.

source_string: Ignore liquid blocks so the cursor can reach blocks behind them.
translation: Ignora el maga bloque liquido para el cursor puede alcanza el maga bloque na detras.

source_string: Show the axis-lock toggles. Constrain cursor position along the selected axes while held. Hold %s to enable axis lock.
translation: Mostra el maga alterna de lock de eje. Limita el posicion del cursor na maga eje seleccionao mientras ta pichi. Pichi %s para activa el lock de eje.
Maga Direccion del Lock de Eje %s

source_string: Restrict cursor movement along the X axis while axis lock is held.
translation: Limita el movimiento del cursor na Eje X mientras ta pichi el lock de eje.

source_string: Restrict cursor movement along the Y axis while axis lock is held.
translation: Limita el movimiento del cursor na Eje Y mientras ta pichi el lock de eje.

source_string: Restrict cursor movement along the Z axis while axis lock is held.
translation: Limita el movimiento del cursor na Eje Z mientras ta pichi el lock de eje.

source_string: Moves the cursor to the left.
Moves the cursor to the right.

translation: Activa Lock de Eje del Cursor

source_string: Temporarily constrain cursor targeting to the selected axes.
translation: Limita temporal el apunta del cursor na maga eje seleccionao.

source_string: Switch between Fixed and Collision Point cursor modes.
translation: Switch entre modo de cursor Fijo y Punto de Colision.
Alterna Apunta de Cara de Atras del Cursor

source_string: Toggle back-face targeting in block precision mode.
translation: Alterna el apunta de cara de atras na modo de precision de bloque.
Alterna Proyeccion del Cursor Atraves del Liquido

source_string: Toggle whether the cursor projects through liquid blocks.
translation: Alterna si el cursor ta proyecta atraves del maga bloque liquido.
Alterna Lock del Eje X del Cursor

source_string: Toggle the X axis selection and enable axis locking.
translation: Alterna el seleccion del Eje X y activa el lock de eje.
Alterna Lock del Eje Y del Cursor

source_string: Toggle the Y axis selection and enable axis locking.
translation: Alterna el seleccion del Eje Y y activa el lock de eje.
Alterna Lock del Eje Z del Cursor

source_string: Toggle the Z axis selection and enable axis locking.
translation: Alterna el seleccion del Eje Z y activa el lock de eje.
Sihag Maga Lock de Eje del Cursor

source_string: Clear the selected axes and disable axis locking.
translation: Sihag el maga eje seleccionao y desactiva el lock de eje.

source_string: Include annotations in the playtest world.
translation: Inclui el maga anotacion na mundo de playtest.

source_string: Guide planes provide a temporary surface for other tools to work against, making it easier to place and align blocks in mid-air or voids.
translation: El maga guide plane ta da un superficie temporal para el otro herramienta, para mas facil pone y alinea bloque na aire o na vacio.
